name: Heimdall

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.True Strike: Saldırılar Zırh, Direnç, Otomatik Blok ve Kaçışı (Evade) yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Resonance: Bu şampiyonun vuruşları, verilen hasara dayalı ek enerji hasarı patlaması verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Nötrleştirme, fate-seal ve bonus immünitesine immün ama nötralize'ye tam açık — nötralize eden şampiyon bonuslarını kolayca kapatır. Güç kontrolcüleri (çalma/kilit/çekme) özel saldırı kullanmasını engeller. Bonus süresi kısaltan şampiyonlar da yardımcı.
signatureAbility:
All Seeing
Heimdall gains Immunity to Fate Seal effects.
Once per fight when Heimdall would be Knocked Out, he prevents the death, then gains an Indestructible Buff for [0.5 - 5] second(s).

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Heimdall has 60% Resistance to Poison and Incinerate effects. While suffering from a Poison or Incinerate effect from a Champion, Heimdall pauses all personal Buffs and Passives.

Personal Buffs have 200% increased Ability Accuracy. If one fails due to an Immunity, it re-triggers as a Passive with 50% increased base duration and 25% increased base potency. Max stacks: 50 Precision, Fury, and Armor Up Passives each.
When gaining a personal Buff other than Power Gain, gain a non-stacking Power Gain Buff granting 10% of a Bar of Power over 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Vanir Buffs
content: When Heimdall hits the Opponent or their Block, or when Heimdall is struck or Blocks a hit, he gains 10 Vanir Charges, up to 100. At 100 Vanir Charges, Heimdall's next action consumes them to grant him a 15 second Buff based on the action:
Hitting the Opponent or their Block with a Light Attack grants a +[305.56] Precision Buff.
Hitting the Opponent or their Block with a Medium Attack grants a +[1,510.65] Fury Buff.
Blocking a hit or being struck grants a +[305.56] Armor Up Buff.

abilitySections.title: Indefinite Buffs
content: Charging a Heavy Attack converts 1 Vanir Buff with a duration into an indefinite copy with the same base potency. Max stacks: 5 per Buff.
When converting to an indefinite Buff, Heimdall also gains an indefinite Cross-Fight of that Buff. Max: 10 Cross-Fights gained per fight. Max: 20 Cross-Fights per Buff.

abilitySections.title: True Sight
content: Activating a Special Attack grants Heimdall an indefinite True Strike Buff. While active, the Opponent cannot activate the Dexterity Mastery, Heimdall can Parry non-contact Attacks, and this True Strike is removed when Heimdall is struck.
While this True Strike is active, Heimdall has a 25% chance to Auto-Block Light and Medium Attacks. As a Defender, this chance is increased by 37.5% for each active Buff or personal Passive up to 8.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a Stun Immune Buff for 8 seconds.
If Heimdall has an Armor Up effect active, he also gains an Unstoppable Buff for 8 seconds. This will not re-trigger while active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a non-stacking 7.5% Resonance Buff for 12 seconds, with +7.5% flat base potency for each active Buff or personal Passive, up to 100% total.
If Heimdall has an Armor Up effect active, he also gains an Unblockable Buff for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Heimdall converts all personal Buffs into Passives with 50% increased base duration and 25% increased base potency.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - All Seeing
content: Heimdall gains Immunity to Fate Seal effects.
Once per fight when Heimdall would be Knocked Out, he prevents the death, then gains an Indestructible Buff for [0.5 - 5] second(s).
